sources.title: AI customer review analysis: How it works and how to do it (2026)
sources.snippet: AI review analysis uses natural language processing to read thousands of customer reviews at once and pull out sentiment, themes, and patterns that a human team would take weeks to find. Most businesses shopping for review analysis software don't have an analysis problem. They have a volume problem, and volume has a threshold.

sources.title: How to Conduct Sentiment Analysis on Reviews [2 Methods]
sources.snippet: Sentiment analysis for customer reviews is the process of classifying feedback as positive, negative, or neutral to understand what customers love, what frustrates them, and what needs improvement. Manual review analysis works only for small datasets under 100 reviews, but it is slow, biased, inconsistent, and impossible to scale for growing businesses.
